label: Evidence-weighted milestone estimate
endpoint: Repeatable kernel exploit on firmware 14.10; hypervisor bypass excluded
interpretation: A subjective milestone rubric, not an objective fraction of unknown work, time remaining, probability of success, or vulnerability coverage.

milestones.title: 14.10 research environment
milestones.note: Firmware-tagged Lua execution and observable userland behavior are recorded.

checks.label: Firmware identified in a captured session

milestones.title: Probe tooling and captured evidence
milestones.note: Runner source and dated output logs are present; counts measure artifacts, not successful exploits.

milestones.title: Target characterization
milestones.note: Exhaustive syscall survey (664 probes), sysent boundary measured at 676 entries, 39 userland modules enumerated, CClosure redirect confirmed (56c/56f), thread ROP execution via thr_create(430), arbitrary userland calls via fcall_with_rax, C11 threading, UMTX PI mutex. 13.60 Ghidra decompile of set_mcontext validates thr_create panic root cause as kernel candidate.

checks.label: Complete scoped survey with reconciled current summary
Target-build analysis validates a kernel candidate

milestones.title: Kernel attack surface mapping
milestones.note: 12+ CVEs assessed against 14.10 (all blocked/stubbed). 70+ dead ends mapped with root causes. 34/76 device nodes inventoried, ioctl encoding discovered (Sony NID-hash). UMTX orphaned kernel waiter primitive proven (274e/274f). getsockopt 214 options swept, 17 KASLR techniques tested. Active kernel attack surface: PI chain exploitation in progress.

checks.label: CVE and public technique assessment against target firmware
Systematic dead-end mapping eliminates blind alleys
Active kernel-touching primitive identified with exploitation path

milestones.title: Validated 14.10 kernel vulnerability
milestones.note: No qualifying root-cause analysis and controlled 14.10 reproduction established. UMTX orphaned waiter touches kernel state but corruption is not yet demonstrated.

checks.label: Kernel vulnerability root cause supported on 14.10

milestones.title: Demonstrated 14.10 kernel read/write
milestones.note: No verified kernel read/write demonstration found.
